items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: we played the Fillmore Auditorium in San Francisco on Easter Sunday with James Brown, Leslie Hawkins -- who is getting big now -- Arnett Cobb, band backing them up

ctx.x: So he sent and got him. And he's put a lot of money out behind him. He bought him transportation, uniforms, hired a guy how to teach him how to get on the stand and off and put -- he ended up spending about $25,000.00. So I mean that's all along, you know.

We left here in '58 going to California on a tour, and we played the Fillmore Auditorium in San Francisco on Easter Sunday with James Brown, Leslie Hawkins -- who is getting big now -- Arnett Cobb, band backing them up, and Little Willie Johns. And you could throw a brick in the place and it wouldn't hit nobody -- on Easter Sunday. Well, they had 200 people in there, but the place was big, and they're scattered, and you can't tell how many.
